description: Search for Salesforce tasks using multiple criteria like subject, status, priority, assigned user, related records, or dates. Always provide at least one filter criterion — no filters produces broad, slow results. For complex filtering not supported here, use salesforce.run_soql_query.

account_name.description: Search by related account name. Supports partial matches.
account_name.human_parameter_description: The account linked to the task you’re looking for. Type the account’s name or part of it.
account_name.title: Account Name

activity_date_from.description: Search tasks with activity date from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Date filtering may not strictly bound results; verify ActivityDate in returned records when date accuracy matters.
activity_date_from.human_parameter_description: The earliest due date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Use this to show tasks due on or after this date.
activity_date_from.title: Activity Date From

activity_date_to.description: Search tasks with activity date before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
activity_date_to.human_parameter_description: The latest due date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Use this to show tasks due on or before this date.
activity_date_to.title: Activity Date To

assigned_to_name.description: Search by assigned user name. Supports partial matches.
assigned_to_name.human_parameter_description: The name of the person the task is assigned to. Enter a full or partial name to find their tasks.
assigned_to_name.title: Assigned To Name

contact_name.description: Search by related contact name. Supports partial matches.
contact_name.human_parameter_description: The contact associated with the task. Enter the person’s name or part of it to match.
contact_name.title: Contact Name

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Task fields to retrieve. WhoId/Who.Name, WhatId/What.Name, OwnerId/Owner.Name, and Description can be null on Task records — guard against null before accessing nested .Name fields. Call-specific fields (CallType, CallDurationInSeconds) are frequently null and unreliable as sole filters.
fields.human_parameter_description: A comma-separated list of task fields to return. Keep the default unless you need specific columns.
fields.title: Fields

is_closed.description: Filter by closed status. True for completed tasks, False for open tasks.
is_closed.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to show completed tasks (true) or open tasks (false). Leave blank to include both.
is_closed.title: Is Closed

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return. Maximum is 2000. When returned record count equals limit or nextRecordsUrl is present in the response, paginate to retrieve all matching tasks.
limit.human_parameter_description: The maximum number of tasks to return. Increase for more results or decrease for a shorter, faster list.
limit.title: Limit

priority.human_parameter_description: The priority level to filter by (High, Normal, or Low). Use this to focus on more important tasks.
priority.title: Priority

status.human_parameter_description: The task status to filter by, like Not Started or Completed. Use this to see tasks at a specific stage.
status.title: Status

subject.description: Search by task subject. Supports partial matches. Many Tasks are system-generated or email-related; combine with activity_date_from/activity_date_to, status, and priority for better precision.
subject.human_parameter_description: Words from the task’s subject you want to search for. Enter part of the title to find matching tasks.
subject.title: Subject

name: search_tasks

SearchTasksResponse.description: Response from searching Salesforce tasks. Supports custom fields via extra='allow'.

done.description: Boolean indicating if all records have been retrieved. When false, more records are available via nextRecordsUrl.
done.title: Done

nextRecordsUrl.description: Query identifier URL used to retrieve the next batch of records when results exceed 2000 records. Only present when done is false.
nextRecordsUrl.title: Next Records Url

records.description: Array of Task records returned by the query.
records.title: Records

totalSize.description: Total number of records matching the query.
totalSize.title: Total Size

SearchTasksResponse.title: SearchTasksResponse

TaskRecord.description: A Salesforce Task record. Supports custom fields via extra='allow'.

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the task has been soft deleted.
IsDeleted.title: Is Deleted

ReminderDateTime.description: The date and time when a reminder is scheduled to fire for the task.
ReminderDateTime.title: Reminder Date Time

RecurrenceRegeneratedType.description: What triggers the task to repeat. Values include 'After due date' and 'After date completed'.
RecurrenceRegeneratedType.title: Recurrence Regenerated Type

CompletedDateTime.description: Date and time when the task was completed. This field is set automatically by the system when the task status is marked as completed.
CompletedDateTime.title: Completed Date Time

IsReminderSet.description: Indicates whether a reminder has been set for the task.
IsReminderSet.title: Is Reminder Set

RecurrenceMonthOfYear.description: The month of the year on which the task repeats.
RecurrenceMonthOfYear.title: Recurrence Month Of Year

RecurrenceDayOfMonth.description: Day of the month (1-31) on which the task recurs. If the specified day exceeds the days in a month, the last day of that month is used.
RecurrenceDayOfMonth.title: Recurrence Day Of Month

TaskSubtype.description: Standard subtypes to facilitate creating and searching for specific task subtypes. This field is createable but not updateable.
TaskSubtype.title: Task Subtype

Status.description: The current status of the task (e.g., 'Not Started', 'In Progress', 'Completed').
Status.title: Status

RecurrenceStartDateOnly.description: The date when the recurring task begins.
RecurrenceStartDateOnly.title: Recurrence Start Date Only

IsVisibleInSelfService.description: Indicates whether the task is visible in self-service portals.
IsVisibleInSelfService.title: Is Visible In Self Service

RecurrenceInstance.description: Picklist field indicating the frequency of the recurring task (e.g., '1st', '2nd', '3rd').
RecurrenceInstance.title: Recurrence Instance

Description.description: Detailed description or notes about the task.
Description.title: Description

AccountId.description: ID of the related Account. This field is automatically populated based on WhoId or WhatId and is not directly writable.
AccountId.title: Account Id

IsClosed.description: Indicates whether the task is closed or completed.
IsClosed.title: Is Closed

CreatedDate.description: The date and time when the task was created.
CreatedDate.title: Created Date

IsArchived.description: Indicates whether the task has been archived.
IsArchived.title: Is Archived

RecurrenceActivityId.description: ID that links recurring task instances together.
RecurrenceActivityId.title: Recurrence Activity Id

OwnerId.description: ID of the user who owns the task.
OwnerId.title: Owner Id

EmailMessageId.description: ID of the related EmailMessage record when the task is associated with an email.
EmailMessageId.title: Email Message Id

Subject.description: The subject or title of the task.
Subject.title: Subject

WhoId.description: ID of the related Lead or Contact. Represents the person associated with the task.
WhoId.title: Who Id

RecurrenceEndDateOnly.description: The last date on which the task repeats.
RecurrenceEndDateOnly.title: Recurrence End Date Only

LastModifiedById.description: ID of the user who last modified the task.
LastModifiedById.title: Last Modified By Id

Priority.description: The priority level of the task (e.g., 'Normal', 'High', 'Low').
Priority.title: Priority

WhatId.description: ID of the related non-person record such as Account, Opportunity, or Custom Object. Represents what the task is related to.
WhatId.title: What Id

RecurrenceInterval.description: The number of days between the trigger (due date or close date) and the due date of the next repeating task.
RecurrenceInterval.title: Recurrence Interval

CreatedById.description: ID of the user who created the task.
CreatedById.title: Created By Id

RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask.description: Bitmask indicating the day(s) of the week on which the task repeats. Values: Sunday=1, Monday=2, Tuesday=4, Wednesday=8, Thursday=16, Friday=32, Saturday=64.
RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask.title: Recurrence Day Of Week Mask

SystemModstamp.description: The date and time when the task was last modified by a user or automated process. Always greater than or equal to LastModifiedDate.
SystemModstamp.title: System Modstamp

RecurrenceType.description: Indicates how often the task repeats (e.g., 'RecursDaily', 'RecursWeekly', 'RecursMonthly', 'RecursYearly').
RecurrenceType.title: Recurrence Type

CallObject.description: Reference to the related call object.
CallObject.title: Call Object

IsHighPriority.description: Indicates whether the task is marked as high priority.
IsHighPriority.title: Is High Priority

ActivityDate.description: The due date of the task.
ActivityDate.title: Activity Date

RecurrenceTimeZoneSidKey.description: Time zone associated with the recurring task.
RecurrenceTimeZoneSidKey.title: Recurrence Time Zone Sid Key

Id.description: Unique identifier of the Task record.
Id.title: Id

CallDurationInSeconds.description: Duration of the call in seconds for call-type tasks.
CallDurationInSeconds.title: Call Duration In Seconds

CallDisposition.description: Disposition or outcome of the call.
CallDisposition.title: Call Disposition

IsRecurrence.description: Indicates whether the task is a recurring task.
IsRecurrence.title: Is Recurrence

LastModifiedDate.description: The date and time when the task was last modified by a user.
LastModifiedDate.title: Last Modified Date

TaskRecord.title: TaskRecord

url.description: The URL for accessing the details of this record.
url.title: Url
